scope: Source only. Actual atlas author UI and base map UI regression; no alpha21 package/install/upgrade qualification. Source tests also ran on archived alpha20 embedded Node24, not alpha21 ASAR.

checks: actual author controls create manual epoch order and world/city/interior hierarchy with explicit parent anchors; empty epoch name and half-selected anchor reject formal save yet survive modal close and full Electron restart; completing and saving works; filtered directory and open-parent controls navigate exact maps without changing their graph bytes

synthetic atlas storage quota blocks modal/native window close without losing inputs; explicit formal save still works; actual same-revision external file change rejects stale save, readable comparison and explicit baseline retain true preimage history; read-only history adoption creates a new revision without replacing map geometry

formal atlas save with synthetic local cleanup failure blocks duplicate saving/close until retry; cleanup retry does not create another revision; future local schema remains byte-identical and read-only across modal reopen until explicit discard

synthetic competing local cache is retained while the current author explicitly saves formal data; reopen restores the competing draft without silently rebasing, stale baseline blocks save until readable comparison and explicit adoption; both author versions remain in saved history

desktop and 806px light/dark atlas render without horizontal dialog overflow; actual whole-book backup/restore retains saved epochs and three-level references under source lineage, excludes unsaved local notes; original three map files and formal manuscript remain exact, zero renderer errors/HTTP; native folder results are instrumented

unfinished coordinate input survives modal close and full Electron restart; synthetic localStorage quota blocks modal and native window close without losing raw input; completing coordinates and explicitly saving still writes the formal map and clears the close guard

same-revision external edits reject stale saves and retain disk bytes/local input; author explicitly compares and adopts the baseline; exact external preimage survives in history; actual read-only historical background loads and author adopts it as a new revision; keyboard point movement/undo and view-only zoom do not silently write the map

future local draft remains byte-identical and read-only until explicit discard; map recycle and restore preserve identity; a synthetic checkpoint representing an already committed creation with an unconfirmed result reconciles the later revision without duplicate or rewind; not a simulated IPC transport loss

desktop and 806px dark/narrow map render without dialog overflow; actual host backup/restore to a new book preserves saved map IDs, original image and frozen background while excluding unfinished local coordinate input; folder chooser results are instrumented
